title: Prove exact shared-hub two-pentagon query dimension nine (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite conformance, produced by Nick Petalas. Two pentagons sharing one hub have exact fitting rank **nine** when every vertex carries two field coordinates, over every field. All permitted directed 2-by-2 edge blocks are unrestricted. The independent-set bound gives eight, and the new saturation argument excludes it. Nine coordinate pairs attain the minimum.

```text
independent vertices {1,3,5,7} occupy eight query coordinates
    -> terminal subspaces saturate both arms
    -> the hub decoder vanishes if rank is eight
    -> contradiction to its identity diagonal
nine disjoint coordinate pairs attain rank nine
```

This original changed-mask decoder experiment stops at that first sharp result. It does not change the selected #7000 frontier. The six new files are isolated in `research/shared-hub-pentagon-query/`.

Credit JoyboyBrian #5023 and tekuuu #3362 for the odd-cycle block-query interface and the retained P112/native lineage. Berliner and Langberg's classical outerplanar theorem covers scalar coding; this contribution supplies the two-coordinate arbitrary-block result and direct proof. The older Clebsch puncturing package is related background, with a different mask and fixed matrix. No predecessor executable or scientific result is audited or replayed, and no global literature-priority claim is made.

## Evidence

The direct check prints `PASS_SHARED_HUB_PENTAGON_QUERY` and minimum dimension nine in its generated, file-hash-bound JSON result. Normal and optimized checks, registered metadata/pins and both registered replays pass locally with CPython 3.12.15.

- 376 complete factorizations over F2, F3, F5, F7, F101 and Q, checking all 121,824 ordered entries and all factor/matrix ranks. Asymmetric and noncommuting fixtures are included.
- All 262,144 binary inputs, with 4,718,592 coordinate recoveries.
- All 187,200 normalized local branch instances over F2 and F3 used in the written proof. These are not an exhaustive census of arbitrary fitting matrices.
- Twelve illegal/omitted-query mutants reject. A rank-eight code becomes valid after adding only edge `0-2`, and the original mask rejects it.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/shared-hub-pentagon-query/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/shared-hub-pentagon-query/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-hub-pentagon-query
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/shared-hub-pentagon-query --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace that absolute path. The two registered commands were timed locally at 1.79 s and 1.54 s, below their 120-second limits. These times document replay feasibility, not a speedup. Registered replay returns `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`; committed-byte/source-history preflight returns `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` for all six files and ancestor base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Syntax inspection and `git diff --check` pass.

The all-field lower bound is the written proof, not an inference from the finite corpus. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Only this graph, two-coordinate payload and linear fitting contract are settled. Larger payloads, nonlinear coding and other topologies remain unproved. No physical source reads, side-information acquisition, native maps, dirty restoration, frames, coefficient preparation, ownership, hosting, precision/tape/stock, uniform compiler, full recursive invoice or supplier admission is supplied. No new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run.

## Open next questions

- Determine the exact rank with three coordinates per vertex, starting with the possible rank-thirteen case. The saturation argument and ordinary edge pairing leave that case unresolved.
- Bind the nine-query code to an actual chronological caller, then charge every source read, side-information read, query, restoration and delivery. No physical profitability follows from dimension alone.

## Related open work

No open PR found in the publication overlap check studies this two-pentagon shared-hub mask or its unrestricted two-coordinate fitting rank. Merged #5023 supplies the single-cycle background; the older Clebsch puncturing package studies a different mask. Open #7198 studies persistent stock in a chronological common-query stream, and #7269 studies denominator-constrained helper capacity; neither computes the fitting rank of this mask. Their results were not replayed or numerically compared.

- [#7533](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7533) reduces a separate-term A7+A1 COPY family to coding on a different 44-vertex graph. It does not compute this two-pentagon graph's fitting rank; no numerical comparison is asserted.

The pre-DONE refresh read this account's seven other open PRs created since the advance claim: #7527, #7528, #7530 and #7532 through #7535. The remaining subjects are suffix precision, a Euclidean resolvent, permutation tensor layouts, a source-count floor, orthogonal Schur residuals and capped tensor splitting. None computes the shared-hub two-coordinate fitting rank. No extra computations were run to check another contribution.

## CI notes

At unchanged head `a965bcb5b88e2e3a9856e1cc53639b43a896b663`, [Registered research packages run 43467848165](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467848165) finished with **plan failed** and **replay skipped**. **CI did not certify this package.** The local normal/optimized verifier, registered metadata/replay and committed-byte/source-history checks passed as recorded above.

The [plan job 132031654829](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467848165/job/132031654829) failed in `Onboarding helper tests` on exactly one test: `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`. Its log reports `Ran 760 tests` and `FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)`. The assertion says that `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` was not found in the CI verification document.

I read the job log and the corresponding files at main base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while the current section of `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Those files and the failing test are unchanged by this PR. This is a repository-level documentation mismatch. The [package replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467848165/job/132034416669) was skipped after the plan failure.

The same single test, missing-command assertion, 760-test count and `failures=1, skipped=24` result were independently confirmed from the failed-job logs in rohanarun's [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), dillona's [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), and petalas's [#7527 run 43467013583](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467013583), [#7528 run 43467095967](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467095967) and [#7530 run 43467444862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467444862). No fix, retrigger commit or job rerun was made for this shared failure. Only the local checks certify the automated package conformance reported here; the written theorem remains without independent human or formal proof-kernel review.

Advance CLAIM: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19595344. Delivered mathematical scope matches it.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only one six-file research package is added. Shared code, frozen evidence and selected-frontier files are unchanged.
